item.text: The ResStock team recommends **at least 1,000 samples** when no more specific guidance is available. This is a conservative guideline intended to keep sampling discrepancy at roughly **15% or less for many common quantities of interest**. [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html)
